patterns: Each language gets a module file in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/{lang}.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants

Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance) are optional and language-specific
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) for def-use analysis

constraints: All languages unconditionally compiled (no lang-* feature gates); tree-sitter-php must be added to workspace dependencies and always available
Parameter surface is strict: tool schema is the contract; no legacy fields or silently ignored inputs
Workspace lints enforced in CI: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used all deny-level
Dependency freshness: new Cargo.lock entries must be >=7 days old (bypass with SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK=true)
MCP tool output must include .with_meta(Some(no_cache_meta())) on every CallToolResult::success()
Tree-sitter queries must be valid for the grammar; all node kinds and field names must match the grammar's node-types.json
test_coverage: Existing language modules have unit tests for query compilation and handler correctness; integration tests verify parse success, element extraction (functions/classes), and inheritance extraction. New language must pass: (1) query compilation tests, (2) element extraction tests for each declaration kind, (3) inheritance extraction tests, (4) defuse_query tests if implemented, (5) integration tests via analyze_file() with TempDir fixtures.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP constant; node types: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; fields: name (required), body (required), base_clause (extends), class_interface_clause (implements)
library_findings.notes: Grammar defines function_definition for top-level functions and method_declaration for class/interface/trait methods. Classes use base_clause (not parent_class field) for extends and class_interface_clause (not interfaces field) for implements. Enums have enum_declaration_list body. Traits are trait_declaration nodes.

library_findings.relevant_api: Parser::new(), Parser::set_language(), Parser::parse(); Query::new(), QueryCursor::matches(); Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte()
library_findings.notes: All tree-sitter language crates depend on tree-sitter 0.27.1. Query syntax uses @capture names and field accessors like (node_kind field_name: (child_kind) @capture).

library_findings.relevant_api: Comparison reference: method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration; superclass field (extends), interfaces field (implements); DEFUSE_QUERY pattern with local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression, identifier captures
library_findings.notes: Java grammar uses field names superclass and interfaces; PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause. DEFUSE_QUERY in Java distinguishes write.local, write.assign, writeread.update, read.usage capture names.

approaches.name: Full PHP support with all handlers and DEFUSE_QUERY
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for function calls; REFERENCE_QUERY for type identifiers; IMPORT_QUERY for use statements; DEFUSE_QUERY for local declarations and identifier usage. Implement extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, and extract_inheritance handlers. Wire into mod.rs, add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml, register .php extension in lang.rs, add integration tests.
pros: Complete feature parity with Java/Kotlin/Go implementations
Enables def-use analysis for PHP (local variable tracking, assignment tracking)
Supports method receiver type resolution and inheritance extraction
Handles all PHP declaration kinds: functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums
cons: Largest implementation effort (~200-300 LOC for module + tests)
Requires careful field mapping since PHP grammar uses base_clause/class_interface_clause instead of superclass/interfaces
DEFUSE_QUERY complexity: PHP has variable_declaration, assignment_expression, and identifier nodes to capture correctly

approaches.name: Minimal PHP support (element extraction only, no DEFUSE_QUERY)
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY only. Omit DEFUSE_QUERY and all handler functions (set to None in mod.rs). Wire into mod.rs, add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml, register .php extension in lang.rs, add basic integration tests for element extraction and inheritance.
pros: Covers primary use case: symbol table extraction (functions, classes, interfaces, traits, enums)
Simpler testing (no defuse_query tests or handler tests required)
Matches CSS/HTML pattern for languages without full semantic analysis
cons: No def-use analysis for PHP code
No method receiver type resolution (find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver unavailable)
Inheritance extraction requires manual tree walking in tests (no extract_inheritance handler)
Future PRs will need to add DEFUSE_QUERY and handlers

approaches.name: Element extraction + inheritance handlers (no DEFUSE_QUERY, no receiver handlers)
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and extract_inheritance handler. Omit DEFUSE_QUERY, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver. Wire into mod.rs, add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml, register .php extension in lang.rs, add integration tests for element extraction and inheritance.
pros: Covers element extraction and inheritance (extends/implements relationships)
Inheritance handler enables class hierarchy analysis
Simpler than full approach but more complete than minimal
cons: Incomplete semantic analysis compared to Java/Kotlin
extract_inheritance handler requires careful field walking for base_clause and class_interface_clause

recommendation: Approach 1 (Full PHP support). The issue title specifies 'add PHP language support' without limiting scope, and the Java reference implementation includes all handlers and DEFUSE_QUERY. Full support enables def-use analysis, method resolution, and inheritance tracking—features that justify the language addition and align with the project's semantic analysis goals. The complexity is manageable given the tree-sitter-php grammar is well-documented and the Java implementation provides a clear template. The effort (6 files, ~300 LOC) is proportional to prior language additions (Swift, Kotlin).
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
defuse_query_draft:
; write site: local variable declaration
(variable_declaration
  (variable_name (name) @write.local))
; write site: assignment to variable
(assignment_expression
  left: (variable_name (name) @write.assign))
; write site: foreach loop variable
(foreach_statement
  value: (variable_name (name) @write.foreach))
; read site: any identifier or variable reference
(identifier) @read.usage
(variable_name (name) @read.usage)
inheritance_walk_citation: For class_declaration nodes: (1) check for base_clause child node (represents 'extends'); (2) if present, extract the name child of base_clause to get the parent class name; (3) check for class_interface_clause child node (represents 'implements'); (4) if present, iterate its named children to find name nodes, each representing an implemented interface. Source: tree-sitter-php grammar at https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js, where class_declaration is defined with optional($.base_clause) and optional($.class_interface_clause) children.
